AS $function$
  select private.is_app_admin()
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.challenges c
      where c.id=p_challenge_id
        and c.status='published'
        and (c.available_from is null or c.available_from<=now())
        and (c.available_until is null or c.available_until>now())
        and (
          c.access_level='free'
          or (c.access_level='member' and private.user_has_household())

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.user_has_active_entitlement(p_entitlement_key text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select
    exists (
      select 1
      from public.household_members hm
      join public.household_subscriptions hs
        on hs.household_id = hm.household_id
      join public.plan_entitlements pe
        on pe.plan_id = hs.plan_id
      where hm.user_id = (select auth.uid())
        and hm.status = 'active'
        and hs.status in ('trialing','active','comped')
        and (hs.current_period_end is null or hs.current_period_end > now())
        and pe.entitlement_key = p_entitlement_key
    )
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.household_members hm
      join public.household_entitlement_grants heg
        on heg.household_id = hm.household_id
      where hm.user_id = (select auth.uid())
        and hm.status = 'active'
        and heg.entitlement_key = p_entitlement_key
        and heg.starts_at <= now()
        and (heg.ends_at is null or heg.ends_at > now())
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_create_series_streak_badge(p_series_id uuid, p_badge_key text, p_name text, p_consecutive_weeks integer, p_description text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_tier text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_rarity text DEFAULT 'standard'::text, p_active_only_while_current_streak boolean DEFAULT true)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_badge_id uuid;
  v_series_key text;
begin
  if not private.is_content_admin() then
    raise exception 'Content administrator access required';
  end if;

  if p_consecutive_weeks is null or p_consecutive_weeks <= 0 then
    raise exception 'Consecutive weeks must be greater than zero';
  end if;

  select series_key
    into v_series_key
  from public.challenge_series
  where id = p_series_id
    and status <> 'archived';

  if v_series_key is null then
    raise exception 'Challenge series not found';
  end if;

  insert into public.badges (
    badge_key,
    name,
    description,
    rarity,
    badge_scope,
    badge_tier,
    badge_family_key,
    is_active
  )
  values (
    trim(p_badge_key),
    trim(p_name),
    nullif(trim(p_description),''),
    p_rarity,
    'streak',
    p_tier,
    v_series_key || '-streak',
    true
  )
  returning id into v_badge_id;

  insert into public.series_badge_rules (
    challenge_series_id,
    badge_id,
    consecutive_weeks_required,
    active_only_while_current_streak,
    is_active
  )
  values (
    p_series_id,
    v_badge_id,
    p_consecutive_weeks,
    p_active_only_while_current_streak,
    true
  );

  return v_badge_id;
end;
$function$
functions.identity_args: p_series_id uuid, p_badge_key text, p_name text, p_consecutive_weeks integer, p_description text, p_tier text, p_rarity text, p_active_only_while_current_streak boolean

functions.name: admin_create_weekly_challenge
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_create_weekly_challenge(p_series_id uuid, p_title text, p_slug text, p_period_start date, p_description text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_challenge_type text DEFAULT 'weekly'::text, p_access_level text DEFAULT 'free'::text, p_xp_reward integer DEFAULT 0, p_parent_approval_required boolean DEFAULT false, p_status text DEFAULT 'draft'::text, p_steps jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_challenge_id uuid;
  v_step jsonb;
  v_order integer := 0;
begin
  if not private.is_content_admin() then
    raise exception 'Content administrator access required';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1 from public.challenge_series
    where id = p_series_id and status <> 'archived'
  ) then
    raise exception 'Challenge series not found';
  end if;

  insert into public.challenges (
    challenge_series_id,
    period_start,
    period_end,
    title,
    slug,
    challenge_type,
    description,
    access_level,
    xp_reward,
    parent_approval_required,
    schedule_mode,
    status,
    available_from,
    available_until
  )
  values (
    p_series_id,
    p_period_start,
    p_period_start + 6,
    trim(p_title),
    trim(p_slug),
    p_challenge_type,
    nullif(trim(p_description),''),
    p_access_level,
    greatest(p_xp_reward,0),
    p_parent_approval_required,
    'one_time',
    p_status,
    p_period_start::timestamptz,
    (p_period_start + 7)::timestamptz
  )
  returning id into v_challenge_id;

  if jsonb_typeof(p_steps) = 'array' then
    for v_step in select value from jsonb_array_elements(p_steps)
    loop
      if nullif(trim(v_step ->> 'title'),'') is not null then
        insert into public.challenge_steps (
          challenge_id,
          title,
          instructions,
          sort_order,
          xp_reward,
          is_required
        )
        values (
          v_challenge_id,
          trim(v_step ->> 'title'),
          nullif(trim(v_step ->> 'instructions'),''),
          v_order,
          greatest(coalesce((v_step ->> 'xp_reward')::integer,0),0),
          coalesce((v_step ->> 'is_required')::boolean,true)
        );
        v_order := v_order + 1;
      end if;
    end loop;
  end if;

  return v_challenge_id;
end;
$function$
functions.identity_args: p_series_id uuid, p_title text, p_slug text, p_period_start date, p_description text, p_challenge_type text, p_access_level text, p_xp_reward integer, p_parent_approval_required boolean, p_status text, p_steps jsonb

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_link_book_experience(p_book_id uuid, p_item_type text, p_item_id uuid, p_sort_order integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not private.is_content_admin() then
    raise exception 'Content administrator access required';
  end if;

  case p_item_type
    when 'power_verse' then
      insert into public.book_power_verses(book_id,power_verse_id,sort_order)
      values(p_book_id,p_item_id,p_sort_order)
      on conflict(book_id,power_verse_id) do update set sort_order=excluded.sort_order;
    when 'devotional' then
      insert into public.book_devotional_series(book_id,devotional_series_id,sort_order)
      values(p_book_id,p_item_id,p_sort_order)
      on conflict(book_id,devotional_series_id) do update set sort_order=excluded.sort_order;
    when 'prayer' then
      insert into public.book_prayer_prompts(book_id,prayer_prompt_id,sort_order)
      values(p_book_id,p_item_id,p_sort_order)
      on conflict(book_id,prayer_prompt_id) do update set sort_order=excluded.sort_order;
    when 'identity' then
      insert into public.book_identity_truths(book_id,identity_truth_id,sort_order)
      values(p_book_id,p_item_id,p_sort_order)
      on conflict(book_id,identity_truth_id) do update set sort_order=excluded.sort_order;
    when 'challenge' then
      insert into public.book_challenges(book_id,challenge_id,sort_order)
      values(p_book_id,p_item_id,p_sort_order)
      on conflict(book_id,challenge_id) do update set sort_order=excluded.sort_order;
    when 'content' then
      insert into public.book_content_links(book_id,content_item_id,sort_order,relationship_type)
      values(p_book_id,p_item_id,p_sort_order,'companion')
      on conflict(book_id,content_item_id) do update set sort_order=excluded.sort_order;
    else
      raise exception 'Unsupported book experience item type';
  end case;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_schedule_notification_campaign(p_campaign_key text, p_name text, p_template_id uuid, p_audience_type text, p_scheduled_at timestamp with time zone, p_delivery_channels text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_membership_plan_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_household_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_organization_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_group_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_event_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_id uuid;
  v_template_channels text[];
begin
  if not private.can_schedule_notifications() then
    raise exception 'Notification scheduling access required';
  end if;

  select default_channels
    into v_template_channels
  from public.notification_templates
  where id=p_template_id
    and status='active';

  if v_template_channels is null then
    raise exception 'Notification template must be active and DC-approved before scheduling.';
  end if;

  insert into public.notification_campaigns(
    campaign_key,name,template_id,audience_type,
    membership_plan_id,household_id,organization_id,group_id,event_id,
    delivery_channels,scheduled_at,status,created_by
  )
  values(
    trim(p_campaign_key),
    trim(p_name),
    p_template_id,
    p_audience_type,
    p_membership_plan_id,
    p_household_id,
    p_organization_id,
    p_group_id,
    p_event_id,
    coalesce(p_delivery_channels,v_template_channels),
    p_scheduled_at,
    'scheduled',
    (select auth.uid())
  )
  returning id into v_id;

  return v_id;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.approve_dc_content_review(p_review_id uuid, p_creative_alignment boolean, p_word_of_faith_alignment boolean, p_scripture_verified boolean, p_identity_in_christ_alignment boolean, p_child_age_appropriate boolean, p_church_affirming boolean, p_approved_assets_only boolean, p_character_continuity boolean, p_language_style_pass boolean, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_required_ok boolean;
  v_entity_type text;
  v_entity_id uuid;
  v_fingerprint text;
begin
  if not private.can_approve_dc_governance() then
    raise exception 'DC governance approval access required';
  end if;

  select entity_type,entity_id
    into v_entity_type,v_entity_id
  from public.dc_content_reviews
  where id=p_review_id
  for update;

  if v_entity_type is null then
    raise exception 'Review not found';
  end if;

  v_required_ok :=
    coalesce(p_creative_alignment,false)
    and coalesce(p_word_of_faith_alignment,false)
    and coalesce(p_scripture_verified,false)
    and coalesce(p_identity_in_christ_alignment,false)
    and coalesce(p_child_age_appropriate,false)
    and coalesce(p_church_affirming,false)
    and coalesce(p_approved_assets_only,false)
    and coalesce(p_character_continuity,false)
    and coalesce(p_language_style_pass,false);

  v_fingerprint := private.dc_entity_fingerprint(v_entity_type,v_entity_id);

  update public.dc_content_reviews
  set status=case when v_required_ok then 'approved' else 'changes_requested' end,
      reviewer_user_id=(select auth.uid()),
      reviewed_at=now(),
      creative_alignment=p_creative_alignment,
      word_of_faith_alignment=p_word_of_faith_alignment,
      scripture_verified=p_scripture_verified,
      identity_in_christ_alignment=p_identity_in_christ_alignment,
      child_age_appropriate=p_child_age_appropriate,
      church_affirming=p_church_affirming,
      approved_assets_only=p_approved_assets_only,
      character_continuity=p_character_continuity,
      language_style_pass=p_language_style_pass,
      content_fingerprint=case when v_required_ok then v_fingerprint else null end,
      notes=nullif(trim(p_notes),'')
  where id=p_review_id;
end;
$function$
functions.identity_args: p_review_id uuid, p_creative_alignment boolean, p_word_of_faith_alignment boolean, p_scripture_verified boolean, p_identity_in_christ_alignment boolean, p_child_age_appropriate boolean, p_church_affirming boolean, p_approved_assets_only boolean, p_character_continuity boolean, p_language_style_pass boolean, p_notes text

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.begin_checkout_provider_handoff(p_checkout_session_id uuid, p_provider text, p_provider_checkout_id text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_order_id uuid;
begin
  if nullif(trim(p_provider),'') is null
     or nullif(trim(p_provider_checkout_id),'') is null then
    raise exception 'Provider and checkout id are required';
  end if;

  select order_id into v_order_id
  from public.checkout_sessions
  where id=p_checkout_session_id
    and user_id=(select auth.uid())
    and status='created'
    and expires_at>now()
  for update;

  if v_order_id is null then
    raise exception 'Checkout session is unavailable or expired';
  end if;

  update public.checkout_sessions
  set status='provider_pending',
      payment_provider=p_provider,
      provider_checkout_id=p_provider_checkout_id,
      updated_at=now()
  where id=p_checkout_session_id;

  update public.orders
  set status='pending_payment',
      payment_provider=p_provider,
      updated_at=now()
  where id=v_order_id
    and status='draft';
end;
$function$
functions.identity_args: p_checkout_session_id uuid, p_provider text, p_provider_checkout_id text

 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_order_id uuid;
begin
  select order_id into v_order_id
  from public.checkout_sessions
  where id=p_checkout_session_id
    and user_id=(select auth.uid())
    and status in ('created','provider_pending')
  for update;

  if v_order_id is null then raise exception 'Checkout session not found'; end if;

  update public.checkout_sessions
  set status='canceled',updated_at=now()
  where id=p_checkout_session_id;

  update public.inventory_reservations
  set released_at=now()
  where checkout_session_id=p_checkout_session_id
    and released_at is null;

  update public.orders
  set status='canceled',canceled_at=now(),updated_at=now()
  where id=v_order_id
    and status in ('draft','pending_payment');
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.capture_marketing_lead(p_lead_type text, p_source_page text, p_parent_guardian_name text, p_email text, p_child_first_name text, p_child_age smallint, p_parent_guardian_consent boolean, p_marketing_consent boolean, p_consent_text text, p_ip_hash text, p_user_agent_hash text, p_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_id uuid;
  v_email text := lower(trim(p_email));
begin
  if p_lead_type not in ('adventure_club_waitlist','book_launch','general_updates','other') then
    raise exception 'Invalid lead type';
  end if;

  if v_email = '' then raise exception 'Email is required'; end if;
  if not coalesce(p_parent_guardian_consent,false) then
    raise exception 'Guardian consent is required';
  end if;

  insert into public.marketing_leads(
    lead_type,source_page,parent_guardian_name,email,
    child_first_name,child_age,parent_guardian_consent,
    marketing_consent,consent_text,consented_at,
    status,ip_hash,user_agent_hash,metadata,
    last_submitted_at,submission_count
  )
  values(
    p_lead_type,nullif(trim(p_source_page),''),
    nullif(trim(p_parent_guardian_name),''),v_email,
    nullif(trim(p_child_first_name),''),p_child_age,
    p_parent_guardian_consent,p_marketing_consent,
    nullif(trim(p_consent_text),''),now(),
    'active',p_ip_hash,p_user_agent_hash,
    coalesce(p_metadata,'{}'::jsonb),now(),1
  )
  on conflict(lead_type,email) do update
  set source_page=excluded.source_page,
      parent_guardian_name=coalesce(excluded.parent_guardian_name,public.marketing_leads.parent_guardian_name),
      child_first_name=coalesce(excluded.child_first_name,public.marketing_leads.child_first_name),
      child_age=coalesce(excluded.child_age,public.marketing_leads.child_age),
      parent_guardian_consent=excluded.parent_guardian_consent,
      marketing_consent=excluded.marketing_consent,
      consent_text=coalesce(excluded.consent_text,public.marketing_leads.consent_text),
      consented_at=excluded.consented_at,
      status='active',
      ip_hash=excluded.ip_hash,
      user_agent_hash=excluded.user_agent_hash,
      metadata=public.marketing_leads.metadata||excluded.metadata,
      last_submitted_at=now(),
      submission_count=public.marketing_leads.submission_count+1
  returning id into v_id;

  return v_id;

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_notification_deliveries(p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS TABLE(delivery_id uuid, notification_id uuid, user_id uuid, channel text, attempt_count integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  return query
  with candidates as (
    select nd.id
    from public.notification_deliveries nd
    where nd.status='queued'
      and nd.next_attempt_at<=now()
    order by nd.created_at
    for update skip locked
    limit greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_limit,50),200))
  ),
  claimed as (
    update public.notification_deliveries nd
    set status='processing',
        attempt_count=nd.attempt_count+1,
        updated_at=now()
    from candidates c
    where nd.id=c.id
    returning nd.id,nd.notification_id,nd.user_id,nd.channel,nd.attempt_count
  )
  select
    c.id,
    c.notification_id,
    c.user_id,
    c.channel,
    c.attempt_count
  from claimed c;
end;
$function$

functions.name: complete_notification_delivery
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_notification_delivery(p_delivery_id uuid, p_status text, p_provider text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_provider_message_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_last_error text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_retry_minutes integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if p_status not in ('sent','failed','suppressed','queued') then
    raise exception 'Invalid delivery completion status';
  end if;

  update public.notification_deliveries
  set status=p_status,
      provider=p_provider,
      provider_message_id=p_provider_message_id,
      last_error=p_last_error,
      next_attempt_at=case
        when p_status='queued'
          then now()+make_interval(mins=>greatest(coalesce(p_retry_minutes,5),1))
        else next_attempt_at
      end,
      sent_at=case when p_status='sent' then now() else sent_at end,
      metadata=coalesce(metadata,'{}'::jsonb)||coalesce(p_metadata,'{}'::jsonb),
      updated_at=now()
  where id=p_delivery_id;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Delivery not found';
  end if;
end;
$function$
functions.identity_args: p_delivery_id uuid, p_status text, p_provider text, p_provider_message_id text, p_last_error text, p_retry_minutes integer, p_metadata jsonb

functions.name: get_child_achievement_progress
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_child_achievement_progress(p_child_profile_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(badge_id uuid, badge_name text, badge_description text, badge_scope text, badge_tier text, badge_family_key text, rule_id uuid, rule_type text, threshold_value integer, current_value bigint, progress_percent integer, earned boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with metrics as (
    select
      br.id as rule_id,
      case br.rule_type
        when 'xp_threshold' then (
          select coalesce(sum(x.points),0)::bigint
          from public.xp_ledger x
          where x.child_profile_id=p_child_profile_id
        )
        when 'challenge_count' then (
          select count(*)::bigint
          from public.child_challenge_progress ccp
          where ccp.child_profile_id=p_child_profile_id and ccp.status='completed'
        )
        when 'adventure_count' then (
          select count(*)::bigint
          from public.child_adventure_progress cap
          where cap.child_profile_id=p_child_profile_id and cap.status='completed'
        )
        when 'streak' then (
          select coalesce(cs.current_count,0)::bigint
          from public.child_streaks cs
          where cs.child_profile_id=p_child_profile_id and cs.streak_key=br.streak_key
          limit 1
        )
        when 'challenge_type_count' then (
          select count(*)::bigint
          from public.child_challenge_progress ccp
          join public.challenges c on c.id=ccp.challenge_id
          where ccp.child_profile_id=p_child_profile_id
            and ccp.status='completed'
            and c.challenge_type=br.challenge_type
        )
        when 'token_threshold' then (
          select coalesce(sum(atl.amount),0)::bigint
          from public.achievement_token_ledger atl
          where atl.child_profile_id=p_child_profile_id
            and atl.token_type=br.token_type
        )
        when 'activity_event_count' then (
          select count(*)::bigint
          from public.child_activity_events cae
          where cae.child_profile_id=p_child_profile_id
            and cae.event_type=br.activity_event_type
        )
        else null
      end as current_value
    from public.badge_rules br
  )
  select
    b.id,
    b.name,
    b.description,
    b.badge_scope,
    b.badge_tier,
    b.badge_family_key,
    br.id,
    br.rule_type,
    br.threshold_value,
    m.current_value,
    case
      when br.rule_type='manual' or br.threshold_value is null then null
      else least(
        100,
        greatest(
          0,
          floor((coalesce(m.current_value,0)::numeric / br.threshold_value::numeric) * 100)
        )
      )::integer
    end,
    exists(
      select 1 from public.badge_awards ba
      where ba.child_profile_id=p_child_profile_id
        and ba.badge_id=b.id
    )
  from public.badges b
  join public.badge_rules br on br.badge_id=b.id and br.is_active=true
  left join metrics m on m.rule_id=br.id
  where b.is_active=true
    and b.badge_scope <> 'streak'
    and private.can_view_child(p_child_profile_id)
  order by
    case when exists(
      select 1 from public.badge_awards ba
      where ba.child_profile_id=p_child_profile_id and ba.badge_id=b.id
    ) then 0 else 1 end,
    coalesce(br.threshold_value,2147483647),
    b.name;
$function$

functions.name: get_child_book_adventure_steps
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_child_book_adventure_steps(p_child_profile_id uuid, p_book_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(step_type text, source_id uuid, title text, subtitle text, sort_group integer, sort_order integer, is_required boolean, completed boolean, status text, xp_reward integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select *
  from (
    select
      'book'::text as step_type,
      b.id as source_id,
      'Read ' || b.title as title,
      b.subtitle as subtitle,
      0 as sort_group,
      0 as sort_order,
      true as is_required,
      coalesce(cbp.status in ('completed','adventure_completed'), false) as completed,
      coalesce(cbp.status, 'available') as status,
      b.completion_xp as xp_reward
    from public.books b
    left join public.child_book_progress cbp
      on cbp.book_id=b.id and cbp.child_profile_id=p_child_profile_id
    where b.id=p_book_id
      and private.can_view_child(p_child_profile_id)

    union all

    select
      'power_verse',
      pv.id,
      pv.title,
      sp.reference,
      10,
      bpv.sort_order,
      bpv.is_required,
      coalesce(csp.status='memorized',false),
      coalesce(csp.status,'not_started'),
      pv.memorize_xp
    from public.book_power_verses bpv
    join public.power_verses pv on pv.id=bpv.power_verse_id
    left join public.scripture_passages sp on sp.id=pv.scripture_passage_id
    left join public.child_scripture_progress csp
      on csp.power_verse_id=pv.id and csp.child_profile_id=p_child_profile_id
    where bpv.book_id=p_book_id
      and private.can_view_child(p_child_profile_id)

    union all

    select
      'devotional',
      ds.id,
      ds.title,
      (
        select count(*)::text || ' day devotional'
        from public.devotional_days dd
        where dd.devotional_series_id=ds.id
      ),
      20,
      bds.sort_order,
      bds.is_required,
      (
        select count(*) > 0
           and count(*) = count(*) filter (where cdp.status='completed')
        from public.devotional_days dd
        left join public.child_devotional_progress cdp
          on cdp.devotional_day_id=dd.id
         and cdp.child_profile_id=p_child_profile_id
        where dd.devotional_series_id=ds.id
      ),
      case
        when (
          select count(*) > 0
             and count(*) = count(*) filter (where cdp.status='completed')
          from public.devotional_days dd
          left join public.child_devotional_progress cdp
            on cdp.devotional_day_id=dd.id
           and cdp.child_profile_id=p_child_profile_id
          where dd.devotional_series_id=ds.id
        ) then 'completed'
        else 'in_progress'
      end,
      coalesce((
        select sum(dd.xp_reward)::integer
        from public.devotional_days dd
        where dd.devotional_series_id=ds.id
      ),0)
    from public.book_devotional_series bds
    join public.devotional_series ds on ds.id=bds.devotional_series_id
    where bds.book_id=p_book_id
      and private.can_view_child(p_child_profile_id)

    union all

    select
      'identity',
      it.id,
      it.title,
      it.identity_statement,
      30,
      bit.sort_order,
      bit.is_required,
      coalesce(cip.learned,false),
      case when coalesce(cip.learned,false) then 'completed' else 'not_started' end,
      0
    from public.book_identity_truths bit
    join public.identity_truths it on it.id=bit.identity_truth_id
    left join public.child_identity_progress cip
      on cip.identity_truth_id=it.id and cip.child_profile_id=p_child_profile_id
    where bit.book_id=p_book_id
      and private.can_view_child(p_child_profile_id)

    union all

    select
      'prayer',
      pp.id,
      pp.title,
      pp.prompt_text,
      40,
      bpp.sort_order,
      bpp.is_required,
      (cpp.id is not null),
      case when cpp.id is not null then 'completed' else 'not_started' end,
      pp.xp_reward
    from public.book_prayer_prompts bpp
    join public.prayer_prompts pp on pp.id=bpp.prayer_prompt_id
    left join public.child_prayer_progress cpp
      on cpp.prayer_prompt_id=pp.id and cpp.child_profile_id=p_child_profile_id
    where bpp.book_id=p_book_id
      and private.can_view_child(p_child_profile_id)

    union all

    select
      'challenge',
      c.id,
      c.title,
      c.description,
      50,
      bc.sort_order,
      bc.is_required,
      coalesce(ccp.status='completed',false),
      coalesce(ccp.status,'not_started'),
      c.xp_reward
    from public.book_challenges bc
    join public.challenges c on c.id=bc.challenge_id
    left join public.child_challenge_progress ccp
      on ccp.challenge_id=c.id and ccp.child_profile_id=p_child_profile_id
    where bc.book_id=p_book_id
      and private.can_view_child(p_child_profile_id)

    union all

    select
      'activity',
      ci.id,
      ci.title,
      ci.summary,
      60,
      bcl.sort_order,
      bcl.is_required,
      coalesce(ccp.status='completed',false),
      coalesce(ccp.status,'not_started'),
      ci.completion_xp
    from public.book_content_links bcl
    join public.content_items ci on ci.id=bcl.content_item_id
    left join public.child_content_progress ccp
      on ccp.content_item_id=ci.id and ccp.child_profile_id=p_child_profile_id
    where bcl.book_id=p_book_id
      and private.can_view_child(p_child_profile_id)
  ) s
  order by s.sort_group, s.sort_order, s.title;
$function$

functions.name: get_child_book_adventure_summary
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_child_book_adventure_summary(p_child_profile_id uuid, p_book_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(total_steps bigint, required_steps bigint, completed_steps bigint, completed_required_steps bigint, progress_percent integer, ready_for_adventure_completion boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with steps as (
    select *
    from public.get_child_book_adventure_steps(p_child_profile_id,p_book_id)
  )
  select
    count(*)::bigint,
    count(*) filter (where is_required)::bigint,
    count(*) filter (where completed)::bigint,
    count(*) filter (where is_required and completed)::bigint,
    case
      when count(*) filter (where is_required)=0 then 0
      else floor(
        (count(*) filter (where is_required and completed)::numeric
        / count(*) filter (where is_required)::numeric) * 100
      )::integer
    end,
    (
      count(*) filter (where is_required) > 0
      and count(*) filter (where is_required)
        = count(*) filter (where is_required and completed)
    )
  from steps;
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_integration_event(p_provider_key text, p_event_type text, p_direction text, p_entity_type text, p_entity_id uuid, p_status text, p_idempotency_key text, p_request_payload jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, p_response_payload jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, p_last_error text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_provider_id uuid;
  v_id uuid;
begin
  select id into v_provider_id
  from public.integration_providers
  where provider_key=p_provider_key;

  insert into public.integration_events(
    provider_id,event_type,direction,entity_type,entity_id,status,
    idempotency_key,request_payload,response_payload,last_error,
    processed_at,attempt_count
  )
  values(
    v_provider_id,p_event_type,p_direction,p_entity_type,p_entity_id,p_status,
    nullif(trim(p_idempotency_key),''),
    coalesce(p_request_payload,'{}'::jsonb),
    p_response_payload,p_last_error,
    case when p_status in ('succeeded','failed','ignored') then now() else null end,
    1
  )
  on conflict(idempotency_key) do update
  set status=excluded.status,
      response_payload=excluded.response_payload,
      last_error=excluded.last_error,
      processed_at=excluded.processed_at,
      updated_at=now()
  returning id into v_id;

  return v_id;
end;
$function$
functions.identity_args: p_provider_key text, p_event_type text, p_direction text, p_entity_type text, p_entity_id uuid, p_status text, p_idempotency_key text, p_request_payload jsonb, p_response_payload jsonb, p_last_error text

functions.name: register_app_installation
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.register_app_installation(p_installation_key text, p_app_channel text, p_platform text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_app_version text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_device_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_push_provider text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_push_token text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_capabilities jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, p_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_user_id uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_push_device_id uuid;
  v_installation_id uuid;
begin
  if v_user_id is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication required';
  end if;

  if p_app_channel not in ('web','goodbarber','ios_native','android_native','pwa','other') then
    raise exception 'Unsupported app channel';
  end if;

  if nullif(trim(p_push_token),'') is not null then
    if p_push_provider is null
       or p_push_provider not in ('webpush','goodbarber','apns','fcm','other') then
      raise exception 'Valid push provider required when a push token is supplied';
    end if;

    insert into public.push_devices(
      user_id,provider,device_token,platform,device_name,app_version,is_active,last_seen_at
    )
    values(
      v_user_id,p_push_provider,trim(p_push_token),p_platform,
      nullif(trim(p_device_name),''),nullif(trim(p_app_version),''),true,now()
    )
    on conflict(provider,device_token) do update
    set user_id=v_user_id,
        platform=excluded.platform,
        device_name=excluded.device_name,
        app_version=excluded.app_version,
        is_active=true,
        last_seen_at=now(),
        updated_at=now()
    returning id into v_push_device_id;
  end if;

  insert into public.app_installations(
    user_id,installation_key,app_channel,platform,app_version,device_name,
    push_device_id,is_active,last_seen_at,capabilities,metadata
  )
  values(
    v_user_id,trim(p_installation_key),p_app_channel,p_platform,
    nullif(trim(p_app_version),''),nullif(trim(p_device_name),''),
    v_push_device_id,true,now(),coalesce(p_capabilities,'{}'::jsonb),coalesce(p_metadata,'{}'::jsonb)
  )
  on conflict(user_id,installation_key) do update
  set app_channel=excluded.app_channel,
      platform=excluded.platform,
      app_version=excluded.app_version,
      device_name=excluded.device_name,
      push_device_id=coalesce(excluded.push_device_id,public.app_installations.push_device_id),
      is_active=true,
      last_seen_at=now(),
      capabilities=excluded.capabilities,
      metadata=public.app_installations.metadata||excluded.metadata,
      updated_at=now()
  returning id into v_installation_id;

  return v_installation_id;
end;
$function$
functions.identity_args: p_installation_key text, p_app_channel text, p_platform text, p_app_version text, p_device_name text, p_push_provider text, p_push_token text, p_capabilities jsonb, p_metadata jsonb

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_integration_provider_health(p_provider_key text, p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_health_status text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_success boolean DEFAULT NULL::boolean, p_error text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  update public.integration_providers
  set status=coalesce(p_status,status),
      health_status=coalesce(p_health_status,health_status),
      last_health_check_at=now(),
      last_success_at=case when p_success is true then now() else last_success_at end,
      last_error_at=case when p_success is false then now() else last_error_at end,
      last_error=case
        when p_success is true then null
        when p_success is false then p_error
        else last_error
      end,
      updated_at=now()
  where provider_key=p_provider_key;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_worker_token(p_token_key text, p_token text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from private.worker_auth_tokens wat
    where wat.token_key=p_token_key
      and wat.is_active=true
      and wat.token_hash=encode(extensions.digest(p_token,'sha256'),'hex')
  );
$function$

relations.name: admin_daily_metrics
relations.view_definition:
WITH days AS (
         SELECT generate_series((CURRENT_DATE - 29)::timestamp with time zone, CURRENT_DATE::timestamp with time zone, '1 day'::interval)::date AS metric_date
        )
 SELECT metric_date,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.households h
          WHERE h.created_at::date = d.metric_date) AS new_households,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.child_profiles cp
          WHERE cp.created_at::date = d.metric_date) AS new_child_profiles,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.child_challenge_progress ccp
          WHERE ccp.completed_at::date = d.metric_date AND ccp.status = 'completed'::text) AS challenges_completed,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.child_scripture_progress csp
          WHERE csp.memorized_at::date = d.metric_date AND csp.status = 'memorized'::text) AS verses_memorized,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.child_book_progress cbp
          WHERE cbp.completed_at::date = d.metric_date AND (cbp.status = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'adventure_completed'::text]))) AS books_completed,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.household_faith_sessions hfs
          WHERE hfs.completed_at::date = d.metric_date) AS family_faith_sessions,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.event_registrations er
          WHERE er.registered_at::date = d.metric_date) AS event_registrations,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.referral_attributions ra
          WHERE ra.attributed_at::date = d.metric_date) AS referrals_attributed,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.orders o
          WHERE o.paid_at::date = d.metric_date AND (o.status = ANY (ARRAY['paid'::text, 'processing'::text, 'partially_fulfilled'::text, 'fulfilled'::text]))) AS paid_orders,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(o.total_cents), 0::bigint) AS "coalesce"
           FROM public.orders o
          WHERE o.paid_at::date = d.metric_date AND (o.status = ANY (ARRAY['paid'::text, 'processing'::text, 'partially_fulfilled'::text, 'fulfilled'::text]))) AS gross_revenue_cents
   FROM days d
  ORDER BY metric_date;

relations.name: admin_platform_snapshot
relations.view_definition:
SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.households
          WHERE households.status = 'active'::text) AS active_households,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.child_profiles
          WHERE child_profiles.status = 'active'::text) AS active_child_profiles,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.household_subscriptions
          WHERE household_subscriptions.status = ANY (ARRAY['trialing'::text, 'active'::text, 'comped'::text])) AS active_subscriptions,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.organizations
          WHERE organizations.status = 'active'::text) AS active_organizations,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.adventure_groups
          WHERE adventure_groups.status = 'active'::text) AS active_groups,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.child_challenge_progress
          WHERE child_challenge_progress.status = 'completed'::text) AS challenges_completed_all_time,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.child_scripture_progress
          WHERE child_scripture_progress.status = 'memorized'::text) AS verses_memorized_all_time,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.child_book_progress
          WHERE child_book_progress.status = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'adventure_completed'::text])) AS books_completed_all_time,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.reward_unlocks) AS rewards_unlocked_all_time,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.support_tickets
          WHERE support_tickets.status <> ALL (ARRAY['resolved'::text, 'closed'::text])) AS open_support_tickets,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.data_privacy_requests
          WHERE data_privacy_requests.status <> ALL (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'canceled'::text, 'rejected'::text])) AS open_privacy_requests;

relations.name: checkout_session_summary
relations.view_definition:
SELECT cs.id AS checkout_session_id,
    cs.order_id,
    cs.household_id,
    cs.user_id,
    cs.status AS checkout_status,
    cs.payment_provider,
    cs.provider_checkout_id,
    cs.expires_at,
    o.order_number,
    o.status AS order_status,
    o.subtotal_cents,
    o.discount_cents,
    o.shipping_cents,
    o.tax_cents,
    o.total_cents,
    o.currency,
    o.promo_code_id,
    o.created_at
   FROM public.checkout_sessions cs
     JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = cs.order_id;

relations.name: child_active_streak_badges
relations.view_definition:
SELECT status.child_profile_id,
    status.challenge_series_id,
    sbr.id AS series_badge_rule_id,
    sbr.badge_id,
    b.name AS badge_name,
    b.badge_tier,
    b.badge_family_key,
    sbr.consecutive_weeks_required,
    status.active_weeks AS current_weeks,
    status.best_weeks,
    status.current_cycle,
    status.last_completed_period,
    status.is_active AND status.active_weeks >= sbr.consecutive_weeks_required AS is_active
   FROM public.child_series_streak_status status
     JOIN public.series_badge_rules sbr ON sbr.challenge_series_id = status.challenge_series_id AND sbr.is_active = true
     JOIN public.badges b ON b.id = sbr.badge_id AND b.is_active = true;

relations.name: child_level_progress
relations.view_definition:
WITH xp AS (
         SELECT cp.id AS child_profile_id,
            COALESCE(sum(x.points), 0::bigint) AS total_xp
           FROM public.child_profiles cp
             LEFT JOIN public.xp_ledger x ON x.child_profile_id = cp.id
          GROUP BY cp.id
        )
 SELECT xp.child_profile_id,
    xp.total_xp,
    current_level.level_number AS current_level_number,
    current_level.name AS current_level_name,
    current_level.minimum_xp AS current_level_minimum_xp,
    next_level.level_number AS next_level_number,
    next_level.name AS next_level_name,
    next_level.minimum_xp AS next_level_minimum_xp,
        CASE
            WHEN next_level.minimum_xp IS NULL THEN 0::bigint
            ELSE GREATEST(next_level.minimum_xp - xp.total_xp, 0::bigint)
        END AS xp_to_next_level,
        CASE
            WHEN next_level.minimum_xp IS NULL THEN 100
            WHEN current_level.minimum_xp IS NULL THEN 0
            WHEN next_level.minimum_xp = current_level.minimum_xp THEN 100
            ELSE LEAST(100::numeric, GREATEST(0::numeric, round((xp.total_xp - current_level.minimum_xp)::numeric / NULLIF(next_level.minimum_xp - current_level.minimum_xp, 0)::numeric * 100::numeric)))::integer
        END AS level_progress_percent
   FROM xp
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT l.level_number,
            l.name,
            l.minimum_xp
           FROM public.levels l
          WHERE l.is_active = true AND l.minimum_xp <= xp.total_xp
          ORDER BY l.minimum_xp DESC
         LIMIT 1) current_level ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT l.level_number,
            l.name,
            l.minimum_xp
           FROM public.levels l
          WHERE l.is_active = true AND l.minimum_xp > xp.total_xp
          ORDER BY l.minimum_xp
         LIMIT 1) next_level ON true;

SELECT css.child_profile_id,
    css.challenge_series_id,
    cs.series_key,
    cs.name AS series_name,
    css.best_weeks,
    css.current_cycle,
    css.streak_started_period,
    css.last_completed_period,
        CASE
            WHEN css.last_completed_period IS NULL THEN 0
            WHEN timezone(h.timezone, now())::date <= (css.last_completed_period + 13) THEN css.current_weeks
            ELSE 0
        END AS active_weeks,
    css.last_completed_period IS NOT NULL AND timezone(h.timezone, now())::date <= (css.last_completed_period + 13) AS is_active
   FROM public.child_series_streaks css
     JOIN public.challenge_series cs ON cs.id = css.challenge_series_id

relations.name: commerce_readiness_summary
relations.view_definition:
SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.products
          WHERE products.status = 'active'::text) AS active_products,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.products p
             LEFT JOIN public.dc_governance_review_status grs ON grs.entity_type = 'product'::text AND grs.entity_id = p.id
          WHERE p.status = 'draft'::text AND COALESCE(grs.approval_current, false) = false) AS product_drafts_needing_governance,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.products p
             JOIN public.dc_governance_review_status grs ON grs.entity_type = 'product'::text AND grs.entity_id = p.id
          WHERE p.status = 'draft'::text AND grs.approval_current = true) AS approved_products_ready_to_activate,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.checkout_sessions cs
          WHERE (cs.status = ANY (ARRAY['created'::text, 'provider_pending'::text])) AND cs.expires_at > now()) AS open_checkouts,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.orders o
          WHERE o.status = 'paid'::text AND o.paid_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AS paid_orders_24h,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.payment_webhook_events pwe
          WHERE pwe.status = 'failed'::text AND pwe.received_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AS webhook_failures_24h,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.orders o
          WHERE o.status = 'pending_payment'::text AND o.created_at < (now() - '01:00:00'::interval)) AS stale_pending_orders,
    ( SELECT ip.status
           FROM public.integration_providers ip
          WHERE ip.provider_key = 'commerce-primary'::text
         LIMIT 1) AS provider_status,
    ( SELECT ip.health_status
           FROM public.integration_providers ip
          WHERE ip.provider_key = 'commerce-primary'::text
         LIMIT 1) AS provider_health,
    ( SELECT ip.last_success_at
           FROM public.integration_providers ip
          WHERE ip.provider_key = 'commerce-primary'::text
         LIMIT 1) AS provider_last_success_at,
    ( SELECT ip.last_error
           FROM public.integration_providers ip
          WHERE ip.provider_key = 'commerce-primary'::text
         LIMIT 1) AS provider_last_error;

relations.name: dc_governance_review_status
relations.view_definition:
SELECT c.entity_type,
    c.id AS entity_id,
    c.title,
    c.status AS entity_status,
    c.updated_at AS entity_updated_at,
    r.id AS review_id,
    r.status AS review_status,
    r.reviewed_at,
    r.status = 'approved'::text AND r.content_fingerprint = private.dc_entity_fingerprint(c.entity_type, c.id) AS approval_current
   FROM public.dc_governance_entity_catalog c
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT dcr.id,
            dcr.entity_type,
            dcr.entity_id,
            dcr.requested_by,
            dcr.requested_at,
            dcr.status,
            dcr.reviewer_user_id,
            dcr.reviewed_at,
            dcr.creative_alignment,
            dcr.word_of_faith_alignment,
            dcr.scripture_verified,
            dcr.identity_in_christ_alignment,
            dcr.child_age_appropriate,
            dcr.church_affirming,
            dcr.approved_assets_only,
            dcr.character_continuity,
            dcr.language_style_pass,
            dcr.notes,
            dcr.standard_versions,
            dcr.metadata,
            dcr.created_at,
            dcr.updated_at,
            dcr.content_fingerprint
           FROM public.dc_content_reviews dcr
          WHERE dcr.entity_type = c.entity_type AND dcr.entity_id = c.id AND (dcr.status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'changes_requested'::text, 'approved'::text]))
          ORDER BY dcr.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) r ON true;

relations.name: delivery_worker_health
relations.view_definition:
SELECT worker_key,
    max(started_at) AS last_started_at,
    max(completed_at) AS last_completed_at,
    ( SELECT r.status
           FROM public.delivery_worker_runs r
          WHERE r.worker_key = dwr.worker_key
          ORDER BY r.started_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS last_status,
    ( SELECT r.claimed_count
           FROM public.delivery_worker_runs r
          WHERE r.worker_key = dwr.worker_key
          ORDER BY r.started_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS last_claimed_count,
    ( SELECT r.sent_count
           FROM public.delivery_worker_runs r
          WHERE r.worker_key = dwr.worker_key
          ORDER BY r.started_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS last_sent_count,
    ( SELECT r.failed_count
           FROM public.delivery_worker_runs r
          WHERE r.worker_key = dwr.worker_key
          ORDER BY r.started_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS last_failed_count,
    ( SELECT r.suppressed_count
           FROM public.delivery_worker_runs r
          WHERE r.worker_key = dwr.worker_key
          ORDER BY r.started_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS last_suppressed_count
   FROM public.delivery_worker_runs dwr
  GROUP BY worker_key;

relations.name: household_membership_summary
relations.view_definition:
SELECT h.id AS household_id,
    hs.id AS subscription_id,
    mp.plan_key,
    mp.name AS plan_name,
    mp.description AS plan_description,
    hs.status AS subscription_status,
    hs.current_period_start,
    hs.current_period_end,
    hs.cancel_at_period_end,
    COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT pe.entitlement_key) FILTER (WHERE pe.entitlement_key IS NOT NULL), '{}'::text[]) AS plan_entitlements,
    COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT heg.entitlement_key) FILTER (WHERE heg.entitlement_key IS NOT NULL AND heg.starts_at <= now() AND (heg.ends_at IS NULL OR heg.ends_at > now())), '{}'::text[]) AS granted_entitlements
   FROM public.households h
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT s.id,
            s.household_id,
            s.plan_id,
            s.status,
            s.provider,
            s.provider_customer_id,
            s.provider_subscription_id,
            s.current_period_start,
            s.current_period_end,
            s.cancel_at_period_end,
            s.metadata,
            s.created_at,
            s.updated_at
           FROM public.household_subscriptions s
          WHERE s.household_id = h.id AND (s.status = ANY (ARRAY['trialing'::text, 'active'::text, 'comped'::text, 'past_due'::text, 'paused'::text]))
          ORDER BY (
                CASE s.status
                    WHEN 'active'::text THEN 1
                    WHEN 'trialing'::text THEN 2
                    WHEN 'comped'::text THEN 3
                    WHEN 'past_due'::text THEN 4
                    WHEN 'paused'::text THEN 5
                    ELSE 6
                END), s.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) hs ON true
     LEFT JOIN public.membership_plans mp ON mp.id = hs.plan_id
     LEFT JOIN public.plan_entitlements pe ON pe.plan_id = mp.id
     LEFT JOIN public.household_entitlement_grants heg ON heg.household_id = h.id
  GROUP BY h.id, hs.id, mp.plan_key, mp.name, mp.description, hs.status, hs.current_period_start, hs.current_period_end, hs.cancel_at_period_end;

relations.view_definition:
SELECT lead_type,
    count(*) AS unique_leads,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE converted_household_id IS NOT NULL) AS converted_households,
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 0::numeric
            ELSE round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE converted_household_id IS NOT NULL)::numeric / count(*)::numeric * 100::numeric, 1)

   FROM public.marketing_leads
  GROUP BY lead_type;

relations.name: parent_child_progress_summary
relations.view_definition:
SELECT cp.id AS child_profile_id,
    cp.household_id,
    cp.display_name,
    COALESCE(xp.total_xp, 0::bigint) AS total_xp,
    COALESCE(stars.total, 0::bigint) AS weekly_stars,
    COALESCE(badge_count.total_badges, 0::bigint) AS lifetime_badges,
    COALESCE(challenge_count.completed_challenges, 0::bigint) AS completed_challenges,
    COALESCE(scripture_count.verses_memorized, 0::bigint) AS verses_memorized,
    COALESCE(devotional_count.devotional_days_completed, 0::bigint) AS devotional_days_completed,
    COALESCE(book_count.books_completed, 0::bigint) AS books_completed,
    COALESCE(reward_count.unredeemed_rewards, 0::bigint) AS unlocked_rewards
   FROM public.child_profiles cp
     LEFT JOIN public.child_xp_totals xp ON xp.child_profile_id = cp.id
     LEFT JOIN public.child_token_totals stars ON stars.child_profile_id = cp.id AND stars.token_type = 'weekly_star'::text
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS total_badges
           FROM public.badge_awards ba
          WHERE ba.child_profile_id = cp.id) badge_count ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS completed_challenges
           FROM public.child_challenge_progress ccp
          WHERE ccp.child_profile_id = cp.id AND ccp.status = 'completed'::text) challenge_count ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS verses_memorized
           FROM public.child_scripture_progress csp
          WHERE csp.child_profile_id = cp.id AND csp.status = 'memorized'::text) scripture_count ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS devotional_days_completed
           FROM public.child_devotional_progress cdp
          WHERE cdp.child_profile_id = cp.id AND cdp.status = 'completed'::text) devotional_count ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS books_completed
           FROM public.child_book_progress cbp
          WHERE cbp.child_profile_id = cp.id AND (cbp.status = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'adventure_completed'::text]))) book_count ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS unredeemed_rewards
           FROM public.reward_unlocks ru
          WHERE ru.child_profile_id = cp.id AND ru.redeemed_at IS NULL) reward_count ON true;
